decisions.reason: The modular plant concept (MMAK) extends the firm's core mobile processing know-how, and a quantified customer result of over 600,000 euros saved per year shows the firm can read and use early market feedback, so it is well placed to keep refining the product.

A mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established competence, and it has its own web page, so the firm's existing knowledge and its in-house R&D make continued development and commercialisation straightforward.

This second modular plant concept builds on the same knowledge base as A and fits the strategic push toward modular solutions, though it has only a brief mention and no reported results, which leaves some risk that it is merged or consolidated into A.
Mobile trommel screens are a core product line closely tied to the firm's existing expertise and service network, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and improve the machine.
